subject: Keystone: portal onboarding + contractor evidence curation
messages:
From: Mike Larkins <mike.larkins@keystone.io>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: sec-portal@keystone.io
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: portal onboarding + contractor evidence scope

Hey Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Keystone is ready to start the vendor portal onboarding (Vendr) but we have a slight wrinkle: our integration contractor (AuditLane) will be doing the evidence collection and will need scoped upload access for a 2-week sprint.

Two asks to get the ball rolling:
1) Can Redwood provide the minimum evidence checklist and the preferred file naming convention so AuditLane can prep?
2) We need a short-term role for contractors in the portal (upload-only, cannot see other vendors). Is that possible and what audit logs will we get back?

Attached is a first-pass SIG export from our side (SIG stub) — we'd prefer to map to Redwood's CAIQ/SOC2 fields.

Can you loop in the person who will own the evidence curation on Redwood's side? Mike

Attachments: keystone_SIG-draft.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Larkins <mike.larkins@keystone.io>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: portal onboarding + contractor evidence scope

Mike — thanks, this is straightforward. Quick plan below and owner notes.

Summary / next steps:
- I will own the mapping and will circulate a Redwood checklist (minimal CAIQ->SIG mapping) by EOD.
- Camila will set up a "contractor upload" role in Vendr scoped to Keystone only (upload/create proofs; no view across vendor inventory). She will confirm retention/audit-log windows.
- Laura will run a quick QA pass on the keystone_SIG-draft.pdf (we should normalize field ids before the import).

Requirements from your side:
- Please confirm AuditLane's contact email and a short justification (contractor name + company) for the portal admin.
- If Keystone needs AuditLane to sign an NDA or AUP for temporary access, upload that to the portal link we will share.

I've attached our onboarding checklist draft and a sample file-name convention. Camila / Laura — can you action the Vendr role and the checklist edits?

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_portal-onboard-checklist.md (markdown, 4KB)

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: portal onboarding + contractor evidence scope

Looping the ops steps here — I will: 
- Create a role named keystone-contractor-upload (permissions: upload only, attach metadata, cannot list other vendor files).
- Set role TTL to 14 days with automatic revocation and generate a one-time invite link.
- Enable audit logging: we capture uploader email, timestamp, file hash, and object presign id; logs are retained 90 days (can extend for enterprise).

Notes for Laura: after you confirm the SIG->CAIQ mapping I will import the keystone SIG Qs as QNA fragments (we'll keep the original PDF linked). For the file naming convention I used RISK_CO.<question-id>_<vendor>_<date> to make ingestion deterministic.

Plan ETA: role + invite link by 2025-09-30 15:00 PT; QNA fragments and mapping by 2025-10-02.

--Camila
Senior Onboarding Ops, Redwood
